Name: Spawn Supply Crates On Beach
Author: onlythechosen
Description:
[font=Arial][size=3]This mod will spawn the supply crates that are normally found on the beach farm on the beach area.[/size][/font]

[size=4][b]Only works with SDV 1.6![/b][/size]

[b][size=4]How to install:

[/size][/b][font=Arial][size=3]> Unzip the file and put it into your mod folder ( Stardew Valley -> Content -> Mods )
> Make sure you have the latest version of SMAPI installed (at least 4.0.0)[/size][/font]

[b][size=4]Configuration Options (config.json):

[/size][size=3] [/size][/b][size=3] "Enabled": true, // Enable the spawning of supply crates on the beach.
  "MaxSpawnTries": 10, // The maximum number of times to try to find a valid tile to spawn a supply crate.
  "SpawnPercentageChance": 20 // The percentage chance to spawn a supply crate if a valid tile is found.
[size=3]  "NumberOfDays": 2 // [/size]Try to spawn supply crates X number of in game days.
[/size]
